thread:
sam: Heads up — planning to enable new model halley-2.1 in the catalog at the 02:00 UTC change window. Want to confirm fallback ordering and an escape hatch before I kick the deploybot.

deploybot: [deploybot] Dry-run plan uploaded: /deploy dry-run --catalog halley --enable halley-2.1 --weight 20% --fallback halley-1.4,comet-13b --stage staggered

priya: 20% staged roll sounds good. Confirming: fallback order should prefer halley-1.4 over comet-13b (latency/cost tradeoff).

maria: +1. Also please add a short rollback runbook in the release notes: how to pin back to halley-1.4 and how to revoke the quant variant if it misbehaves.

len: Escape hatch proposal: deploybot should auto-pin to the previous stable variant if error-rate > 2% for 5m OR p50 latency increases by > 2x. If we hit that we want instantaneous pin, not a slow drain.

sam: @len that matches my thinking. Can we make the pin immediate (no drain) for the first 5 minutes of the rollout window, then switch to graceful drain after we reach 50%?

deploybot: Proposed policy updated:
```
- phase1 (0-5m): immediate pin to halley-1.4 on trigger (no drain)
- phase2 (5-30m): graceful drain 60s after pin
- metrics triggers: error_rate > 2% OR p50_latency > 2x baseline OR increase in token cost > 30%
```

priya: tiny nit: make sure the error_rate calc excludes 403/401s from auth flakiness (we saw that in last rollout).

maria: Release notes blurb draft:
"Enabling halley-2.1 (staged) — primary fallback halley-1.4, secondary fallback comet-13b. Immediate pin escape hatch on elevated errors or latency. See internal runbook link: https://go/runbooks/halley-2.1"

len: ops-runner will you confirm change window permission and oncall coverage?

ops-runner: Confirmed. Change window 02:00-04:00 UTC, @oncall-team will be paged on trigger. I'll leave an ops contact in the deploybot comment. :thumbsup:

sam: One more thing — can we add a short smoke test that exercise conversational prompts and embeddings sanity check before we lift traffic? Something quick that fails fast.

deploybot: Added pre-lift smoke: 
```bash
# quick sanity
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/generate -d '{"model":"halley-2.1","prompt":"summarize: The quick brown fox"}' | jq .choices
# embeddings check
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.internal/v1/embeddings -d '{"model":"halley-2.1","input":"test vector"}' | jq .data
```

priya: Good. If smoke fails, deploybot should abort and tag @priya @sam for manual review.

maria: I'll add the rollback snippet to the release notes now and link the runbook.

len: LGTM from infra side. I'll be online during the window.

sam: ok proceeding to schedule the deploybot lift at 02:05 UTC with 5m early monitoring. Ping here when it's running. Thanks all. :rocket:
